scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.build:android: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs android debug
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs android debug
scripts.build:android:prod: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs android prod
scripts.build:ios: npm run icons:ios && node scripts/build-app.mjs ios debug
scripts.build:ios:debug: npm run icons:ios && node scripts/build-app.mjs ios debug
scripts.build:ios:prod: npm run icons:ios && node scripts/build-app.mjs ios prod
scripts.build:app: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs all debug
scripts.build:app:debug: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs all debug
scripts.build:app:prod: npm run icons:android && node scripts/build-app.mjs all prod
scripts.icons:android: npm run icons:source && capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath assets
scripts.icons:ios: npm run icons:source && capacitor-assets generate --ios --assetPath assets
